description: A removal the reader asked for, reported by TmContextUsage.OnRemoveItem. The component never edits the snapshot it renders: it says WHAT the reader wants gone and the host decides whether and how to apply it (drop the section, summarise it, re-request the prompt with the entry removed). Item tells the two shapes apart: a null item is a SECTION removal (the whole ContextUsageSection named by SectionKey), a non-null item is a single ENTRY of that section. IsSection answers the same question in one word.
